issue.title: Sidebar collapses unexpectedly on window resize
issue.description:
When resizing the browser window across the `md` breakpoint, the sidebar collapses and **does not restore** its previous state.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open any project with the sidebar expanded
2. Shrink the window below 768 px
3. Widen it again

Expected: the sidebar returns to its expanded state.

comments.author: Mira Novak
comments.body: Reproduced on Safari and Chrome. Looks like the collapsed flag is persisted on breakpoint change.

comments.author: Jonas Weber
comments.body: We should keep the user's preference separate from the responsive auto-collapse.

comments.author: Danny Lee
comments.body: Agreed — I'm splitting the state into `userCollapsed` and `autoCollapsed`. PR coming today.
